subject: Daz
fact: Daz refused to wear the offered armor.
source_quote: Daz refused, saying armor would only slow him down

subject: Daz
fact: Daz believes he is a nobody with no house affiliation and no apparent strategic value.
source_quote: You don't belong to any noble house, your background is a complete mystery, you suddenly show up, and all of a sudden, we're contracted to protect a nobody.

subject: Daz's identity
fact: Daz wants to know why someone in Menzoberranzan paid a lot to protect him, but the reason is not specified in this session.
source_quote: I literally have no idea why there's all this focus on me.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira noticed the anomaly of Daz being protected despite having no noble house or lineage.
source_quote: That is an excellent question. You don't belong to any noble house, your background is a complete mystery, you suddenly show up, and all of a sudden, we're contracted to protect a nobody.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira believes Daz is likely suffering from daddy issues and self-mythologizing.
source_quote: Yes, yes, yes, that's what every orphan thinks. Do you have daddy issues? Do you have mommy issues? Every drow thinks there's some noble things.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym dismissed the threat of Asha Vandree as insignificant compared to Daz's survival.
source_quote: If Daz can't protect himself from a low-level cult initiate of Lolth, then quite frankly, whoever paid for his survival deserves to lose his money.

subject: Nym
fact: Nym stated that the fee for protecting Daz is a price Daz cannot afford.
source_quote: That is a fee... that is a price you cannot afford.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir killed Asha Vandree to prevent her from invoking Lolth's power.
source_quote: The Eldritch Claw Tattoo doesn't announce itself. One moment I was behind her, the next my hands were something else — longer, reaching — and the strikes came in sequence... Asha Vandree did not get another word out.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin grappled Asha Vandree to prevent her from speaking.
source_quote: He crossed the distance and got his hands on her — properly, a full grapple, one hand clamped over her mouth before she could invoke anything else.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira applauded Zalthir's killing of Asha Vandree as a necessary act.
source_quote: Well done, well done, well done! See, he wasn't completely defenseless.

subject: The payer's identity
fact: The identity of the person who paid to protect Daz is not specified in this session.
source_quote: Someone in Menzoberranzan had spent generously — they interrupt you, a lot — to ensure that a male Drow apostate with no house affiliation and no apparent strategic value survived...

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir decided to act decisively when others hesitated.
source_quote: I'm making a call," I said. I stepped in.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes someone had to make the call to kill Asha Vandree, and he was the one who did.
source_quote: Someone had to make the call. I made it. That's all.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum attempted to use divine light against Asha Vandree, but it missed.
source_quote: He leveled something at her — a directed burst of divine light that should have taken her off her feet — and it missed...

subject: Nym
fact: Nym criticized Thorin for not killing Asha Vandree immediately.
source_quote: When attacking a cleric of Lolth, Thorin, one does not just simply grapple them. One takes your blade and cuts their heads off.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira observed that Thorin and the party had made it this far despite their flawed methods.
source_quote: It's amazing that you people have made it this far.

subject: The origin of the contract
fact: The reason the contract to protect Daz was initiated is not specified in this session.
source_quote: For all you know, the reason this all got started was because they all decided to be friends with the wrong drow.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir did not look at Asha Vandree's body after killing her.
source_quote: I didn't look at the body.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir believes his action was true and reasonable, even if others' hesitations were also true.
source_quote: I just happened to also be true.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz asked the obvious question about the contract terms.
source_quote: What is the terms of your contract, just to make sure that I... am alive, or that I won this particular battle?

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira clarified that the contract was to prevent other drow factions from killing Daz.
source_quote: Our terms of our contract were to make sure that the other drow factions didn't get you killed.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira noted that the T'sarran goons were to be handled personally if needed.
source_quote: They'd been prepared to handle the T'sarran contingent personally if it came to that.

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira said the three bravos were not sincere.
source_quote: Three *bravos*. I have found, as a general principle, that a third *bravo* is never sincere.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz thanked the sisters for their help.
source_quote: Hey guys, thanks for the help.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asked what it would cost to retain the sisters.
source_quote: He asked what it would cost.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir recalled a class on decisive action under moral uncertainty.
source_quote: There was a class for this. Decisive action under moral uncertainty — the ethics of necessary violence, or something like that.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz suggested auditing the payer's books.
source_quote: You know what would help? To audit their books.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz wondered if there was more to him than meets the eye.
source_quote: So then maybe there's more to me than meets the eye?

subject: Kaelira
fact: Kaelira said they were not paid to think too hard about Daz's identity.
source_quote: Perhaps, but we're not paid to think that hard.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz described feeling small and very important at the edge of a life-changing question.
source_quote: He called it *standing at the edge of the question that changes everything.* He said you could always recognize it because it made you feel very small and very important at the same time.
